resources.string: Use the Home button to open JellyScope Launcher. Enable this optional helper in Android accessibility settings. It acts only on Home and does not read screen content.
Handles Home to open JellyScope Launcher. Does not read screen content or act on other buttons.
Disabled. Enable JellyScope Launcher in Android settings.
Helper enabled in Android accessibility settings
Helper not enabled in Android accessibility settings
Open JellyScope Launcher checks the target app only. It does not confirm Home-button handling. Some devices do not deliver Home to accessibility services; try your physical remote after enabling.
On Android 13 or later, you may need to allow restricted settings from this helper’s App info before enabling it.
To stop handling Home, disable this helper in Android accessibility settings or uninstall it. Enabling does not change your default Home app, and this helper does not open the launcher at boot.
JellyScope Launcher could not be opened. Check that it is installed and enabled, then try again.
